Name: DeepWoods Seasonal Obelisk
Author: Sandman53
Description:
This will replace the DeepWoods Obelisk with a seasonal verison.

The Obelisk Graphic was made by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/51171631-gweniaczek/]Gweniaczek[/url] and was made to pair with his Statues as Obelisk mod:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4941]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4941[/url]

Elle's Seasonal Building now also includes seasonal obelisks for the Deep Woods. I highly recommend these textures:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1993[/url]

You can of course replace the graphics with whatever you want inside the Assets folder.
